_comment: D-10 borrow fees/availability, from iBorrowDesk only: a rolling ~1-year DAILY history per ticker (fee/rebate/available with the day's low..high), merged append-only so the rolling window accretes into permanent history, plus the keyed v2 all-time backfill below. This softens spec G-05 — borrow history is NOT purely forward-accruing.
_countries_comment: IBKR usa.txt snapshot RETIRED 2026-09-30 (was ["usa"]): iBorrowDesk republishes the same IBKR feed and covers everything the pipeline used it for. Checked against the last three snapshots (2026-09-24/25/28): all 514 universe names IBKR lists have iBorrowDesk history (plus delisted AVB/EA/EQR it no longer lists); fee |diff| median 0.00 bps, IBKR's point value inside iBorrowDesk's daily low..high for 95-99% of names, availability within 5% for ~98%. build_m1's borrow_fees has only ever read history/ (iBorrowDesk); nothing read data_borrow/USA/, whose 41 stored snapshots stay on the volume. A name that joins the universe later is backfilled by iBorrowDesk (rolling year free, all-time via v2), so the old 'a missed snapshot is gone forever' argument no longer holds. Put ["usa"] back to resume it — the fetch code is unchanged.

iborrowdesk._stocks_from: universe is shared with the EODHD config rather than duplicated here; one request per ticker at iborrowdesk_pace_sec, so 503 names take ~9 min

iborrowdesk_v2._comment: ALL-TIME daily OHLC (fee/rebate/available, back to 2015-07) from the keyed v2 API on the Patreon $10+ allowance: 500 units/month, resetting the 1st UTC, 1 unit = 365 days of one symbol. Universe = intraday.json's research names (stocks + market) that THIS pass's iborrowdesk universe also holds: the main pass takes the 92 in tickers.json, watchlist_borrow.json the other 13. Rows merge into history/<T>.json with EXISTING rows winning; the raw payload (figi, previous_identities, full OHLC) lands in history_v2/<T>.json and is the per-symbol done marker. A spent allowance defers the rest to the first run after the reset and never fails the borrow run. Needs IBORROWDESK_API_KEY in runpod/.env.
iborrowdesk_v2._overlap_free_window_days: stop the request short of today at the fewest whole units whose span still overlaps the free endpoint's rolling year by this many days (those days are already in history/). null = all-time, one extra unit per symbol.
